data.name: AddWorkerExternalHelp
data.value: Or add an external worker by payroll key and label (both protected).

data.name: AddWorkerMemberHelp
data.value: Pick a department member to create their worker row.

data.name: AffiliatesHelp
data.value: Only for an integrated enterprise: the other entities the report covers.

data.name: AnnualFactsIntro
data.value: W-2 earnings, hours and weeks per employment for the reporting year — the input to every CRD snapshot.

data.name: ApprovalHelp
data.value: Unapproved profiles still price estimates but flag every line for review. Any rate change removes the approval.

data.name: ApprovedPayrollCostHelp
data.value: The actual from the payroll system; when present it replaces the estimate for this day.

data.name: ArtifactsHelp
data.value: CSV and XLSX in the CRD template column order, checksum-stable for unchanged input, downloadable no-store until purged after the retention window.

data.name: BaseAmountHelp
data.value: Per hour, year, day or shift according to the pay basis.

data.name: CollectionSourceHelp
data.value: How this record was obtained; observer perception is flagged in every report run.

data.name: CompensationIntro
data.value: Employee, role-default and department-default compensation profiles with pay and employer-cost components.

data.name: ConfirmCorrection
data.value: Create a correction run? The exported run stays as filed and is marked corrected.

data.name: ConfirmFreeze
data.value: Freeze this run? A frozen run is immutable; a later recalculation supersedes it.

data.name: ConfirmImport
data.value: Commit the import? Every row creates a new fact version.

data.name: ConfirmVoid
data.value: Void this run? Its export files are purged.

data.name: ContractorsIntro
data.value: Contractors that supply labor contractor employees covered by the second CRD report.

data.name: CostComponentsHelp
data.value: Payroll taxes, benefits, pension and allocated overhead — percent of eligible pay, per hour, per shift or fixed annual, with an optional cap.

data.name: CostRunsIntro
data.value: Internal loaded cost and margin for bids (estimate), calls and deployments (actual). Revenue is only ever an observed number.

data.name: CoverageHelp
data.value: Declared by the employer after reading the CRD guidance; Resgrid never decides whether you must file.

data.name: DashboardIntro
data.value: Protected workforce pay data, internal field costing and California pay data reporting.

data.name: DefaultProfilesHelp
data.value: Role and department defaults price bid estimates and members without an employee profile.

data.name: DemographicRecordIntro
data.value: A compliance officer's record for a worker who has not self-identified.

data.name: DemographicRecordNotice
data.value: Use employment or other reliable records first; observer perception is a last resort and is flagged on every snapshot. A reason is required and audited.

data.name: DemographicsVoluntary
data.value: Answering is voluntary. Declining to state is a valid answer and is reported as such.

data.name: DistanceHelp
data.value: Enter odometer readings or a distance; kilometres are stored as miles.

data.name: EmployerIntro
data.value: The employer identity the CRD report is filed under, with its affiliated entities.

data.name: EstablishmentsIntro
data.value: Every physical location employees are assigned to; the CRD report is filed per establishment.

data.name: ExpectedAnnualUtilizationHelp
data.value: In allocation units per year; spreads fixed annual components and time-based depreciation.

data.name: ExportPayDataReportingNote
data.value: Freeze a validated run and download its CSV / XLSX files and the portal worksheet (no-store, audited).

data.name: ExternalResourceKeyHelp
data.value: A rate schedule entry id here lets bid estimates price vehicle and equipment lines by class.

data.name: FactVersionHelp
data.value: Stored facts are immutable: saving creates a new version that supersedes the current one.

data.name: FieldCostingIntro
data.value: Internal loaded cost and margin for bids, calls and deployments — aggregate categories only.

data.name: HelpCompensation
data.value: Every amount and multiplier is a protected field. Estimates use the employee profile, then the role default, then the department default; the payroll system's approved cost always wins.

data.name: HelpEmployer
data.value: Coverage is declared by you, never determined by Resgrid. Identifiers and addresses are protected fields; a REDACTED value left unchanged keeps what is stored.

data.name: ImportHelp
data.value: Paste the payroll export in the canonical column order. A dry run validates and reconciles every row before anything commits; imported facts arrive unapproved.

data.name: JobCategoryHelp
data.value: One of the ten CRD job categories of the reviewed schema profile.

data.name: LinesHelp
data.value: Personnel lines carry no rate in the clear; the priced detail is a protected field shown only with a current grant.

data.name: LinesRequireCompensationView
data.value: Lines are visible with View workforce compensation; the summary above is the aggregate view.

data.name: ManagePayDataReportingNote
data.value: The CRD report wizard: runs, employee snapshots, overrides, aggregation, validation, remarks, certification observation, corrections and the compliance officer's demographic records. Every member always answers their own response without it.

data.name: ManageWorkforceCompensationNote
data.value: Employer identity, establishments, workers, employment periods, job assignments, compensation profiles and components, work entries and annual pay fact imports. Values still need a current Protected Data Grant.

data.name: MarkCertifiedHelp
data.value: Only what you observed in the CRD portal after certifying there; Resgrid never certifies.

data.name: MyDemographicsIntro
data.value: Answer or update your voluntary self-identification for California pay data reporting.

data.name: NoArtifacts
data.value: No export files — freeze and export a validated run.

data.name: NoFacts
data.value: No annual pay facts for this year and report type.

data.name: NoRows
data.value: No aggregate rows yet — aggregate after the snapshots are complete.

data.name: NoSnapshots
data.value: No snapshots yet — build them first.

data.name: NoWorkEntries
data.value: No work entries in this window.

data.name: PayComponentsHelp
data.value: Differentials, incentives and specialty pay on top of the base. Fixed-period components are not paid on overtime unless flagged per overtime hour.

data.name: PayDataDisclaimer
data.value: Resgrid prepares and exports; it never files, never decides whether you are covered and never certifies. Everything on these screens is a protected field and is served no-store.

data.name: PayDataIntro
data.value: Prepare the California CRD Payroll Employee and Labor Contractor Employee reports; you file them yourself in the CRD portal.

data.name: PersonnelRoleHelp
data.value: Used to pick a role-default compensation profile when the employee has none.

data.name: PreviewEightHours
data.value: Loaded cost of a regular 8-hour day

data.name: ProtectedNotice
data.value: Identifiers, addresses, pay rates, earnings, demographic responses and export files are Advanced Data Protection fields (catalog 28). They render REDACTED without a current Protected Data Grant and are never cached or logged.

data.name: ProvenanceHelp
data.value: Where the identity came from (contract, W-9, portal record).

data.name: RaceHelp
data.value: Select every category that applies; two or more are reported as multiracial.

data.name: Race_D
data.value: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

data.name: RateMultipliersHelp
data.value: JSON by pay code; missing codes use 1.5 (overtime), 2 (double time) and 1.

data.name: RegularHourlyEquivalentHelp
data.value: Optional override; otherwise derived from the base amount and standard hours.

data.name: ResourceComponentsHelp
data.value: Fuel (rate, or consumption × unit price), maintenance (manual or rolling work-order actual with a meter window), tires, insurance, lease, storage, fixed overhead and consumables.

data.name: ResourceCostsIntro
data.value: Depreciation, fuel, maintenance and fixed costs per unit, asset or external resource class.

data.name: ResourceProfilesHelp
data.value: Plain numeric data gated by View internal costs — no person is priced here.

data.name: Review_no_employment_for_member
data.value: no employment period for the member

data.name: RunBidEstimateHelp
data.value: Bid lines × department-default compensation and class resource profiles; revenue = the bid's estimated total.

data.name: RunCallCostHelp
data.value: Work entries and usage readings recorded against the call; no revenue.

data.name: RunDeploymentCostHelp
data.value: Approved daily time reports, usage readings and expenses through the date.

data.name: RunRemarksHelp
data.value: Up to 500 characters; required when Box 1 earnings were used or an exempt proxy applies.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The change could not be saved.

data.name: SelfIdentificationNotice
data.value: Your answers are stored separately from your personnel record, encrypted, and used only to prepare the aggregate CRD report. Nobody in the department sees them on any other screen.

data.name: SnapshotsHelp
data.value: One row per California employee in the snapshot period; demographic code, earnings and hourly rate are protected fields. Overrides need a reason and are audited.

data.name: UsageIntro
data.value: Odometer, engine meter, hours and fuel readings per unit and day; distance is stored in miles and conflicting readings are queued for review.

data.name: UsefulLifeQuantityHelp
data.value: Miles, hours or days over the life; straight-line = (cost − salvage) ÷ life.

data.name: Validation_earnings_box1_fallback
data.value: W-2 Box 1 used instead of Box 5 (remark required)

data.name: Validation_employee_count_mismatch
data.value: row employee counts do not reconcile to the snapshots

data.name: Validation_employer_identity_missing
data.value: employer identity incomplete (name, FEIN, SEIN, EDD address)

data.name: Validation_file_too_large
data.value: export would exceed the portal file size limit

data.name: Validation_job_category_unknown
data.value: job category not in the schema profile

data.name: Validation_observer_perception_used
data.value: observer perception used for the demographic code

data.name: Validation_profile_stale
data.value: schema profile changed since the run was created

data.name: Validation_remote_counts_mismatch
data.value: remote counts do not reconcile to the employee count

data.name: Validation_snapshot_outside_window
data.value: snapshot period outside the allowed window

data.name: ViewInternalCostsNote
data.value: Aggregate field-cost summaries and margins for bids, calls and deployments — categories and totals, never a line, rate or person — plus resource cost profiles and usage readings.

data.name: ViewWorkforceCompensationNote
data.value: Read compensation profiles, work entries, annual pay facts and cost-run lines. Values still need a current Protected Data Grant.

data.name: WhyWeAskText
data.value: California Government Code section 12999 requires covered employers to report pay data grouped by job category, race/ethnicity and sex. The report contains only aggregate counts and rates; it never names anyone.

data.name: WizardSteps
data.value: 1. Build the employee snapshots · 2. Aggregate the rows · 3. Validate · 4. Freeze and export · then attest in the CRD portal and record the certification here.

data.name: WorkEntriesIntro
data.value: Hours per worker and day from payroll, deployments and calls; the payroll-approved cost, when present, replaces any estimate.

data.name: WorkModeRemoteOutsideCaliforniaAssignedToCaliforniaEstablishment
data.value: Remote outside California (assigned to a CA establishment)

data.name: WorkerIntro
data.value: Employment periods never overlap; each period carries its job assignments over time.

data.name: WorkersIntro
data.value: Every person the department pays or reports on — members and external workers — with their employment periods.

data.name: WorksheetIntro
data.value: The employer-level values you type into the CRD portal alongside the uploaded file.

data.name: WorksheetNoStore
data.value: Served no-store and audited; close the tab when done. Resgrid never signs in to the portal.
